commentary: Bayer Leverkusen have done it—a two-one victory over Augsburg in Matchday 34 seals an unbeaten Bundesliga season, a historic first for any club in the league's history.
Boniface strikes in the eleventh minute—clinical finish from close range, Leverkusen ahead, and the invincibles are rolling!
Andrich converts brilliantly inside the box—two-nil! Leverkusen's midfield maestro extends their commanding lead!
Augsburg pull one back through Komur on sixty one minutes but it´s not enough. So the Leverkusen party can start!

Bayer Leverkusen absolutely demolished Bochum five-nil in a devastating display of attacking football on matchday 33. With Bochum reduced to ten men after just fourteen minutes, Leverkusen ran absolutely riot.
Passlack's fourteenth-minute dismissal leaves Bochum fighting uphill from the start in this crucial contest.
Schick's clinical finish breaks the deadlock—one of his seven for this magnificent unbeaten campaign!
Boniface converts a penalty at the start of the second half – Leverkusen's dominance is complete, two-nil and completely comfortable!
Adli makes it three nil on seventy five.
Stanisic fires in the fourth in the 85th minute, Leverkusen are playing dream football!
And finally Grimaldo taps in from close range in the 92nd minute to complete the rout!
Bayer Leverkusen absolutely demolished Eintracht Frankfurt five-one in Round 32, keeping their season long unbeaten record firmly on track.
Xhaka's magic puts Leverkusen ahead in the eleventh minute—one of his three for the campaign.
Ekitike levels from a tight angle in the 31st minute, Leverkusen's dominance proves unstoppable in their historic run.
Schick finishes clinically from that tight angle just before halftime!
Palacios strikes clinically at 57th minutes—one of his four for the campaign—and Leverkusen are completely in control!
Frimpong nets in the 76th minute, and Leverkusen are cruising toward another stunning victory!
Boniface strikes in the 88th minute—another clinical finish and another impeccable Leverkusen performance!
In a thrilling Round 31 clash, Bayer Leverkusen drew two-two with Stuttgart. There was high drama late on when Leverkusen equalised in the 95th minute to keep their unbeaten record intact.
Fuhrich strikes against the odds on 46 minutes—Stuttgart lead, and Leverkusen's invincibility will demand answers today.
Incredibly Stuttgart go two-nil up thanks to an Undav strike in the 56th minute - how will Leverkusen's respond?!
Adli strikes from a difficult angle on sixty—is the comback on?!
Andrich from a tight angle in the 95th minute secures the draw —incredible scenes from the Invincibles!
Leverkusen and Dortmund played out a tight one-one draw in Round 30. Leverkusen dramatically snatched a late equaliser in added time to keep their incredible unbeaten run going.
Frimpong shoots from a tight angle in the seventh minute, a difficult chance that tests Kobel's reflexes early on!
Tella shoots from close range in the 67th minute —a moment of pure striker's instinct that nearly breaks the deadlock!
Eightieth minute goal! Füllkrug gives Dortmund a one-nil lead
Pure drama as Stanišić levels the scores in the 96th minute. Leverkusen continue this incredible season unbeaten!
Bayer Leverkusen have absolutely demolished Werder Bremen five-nil in Round 29, clinching the Bundesliga title in commanding fashion.
Boniface strikes clinically in the 24th minute—Leverkusen break the deadlock and the Invincibles are underway!
Xhaka strikes from an impossible angle in the 59th minute—what a finish! Two-nil Leverkusen.
Wirtz with an absolutely sublime finish on 67 minutes, three-nil, and Leverkusen are simply unstoppable!
Wirtz strikes again in the 82nd minute—that's four! The creative genius adds another as Leverkusen cruise toward an emphatic victory!
Wirtz yet again, a superb hatrick on 89! Completing the demolition.

Bayer Leverkusen secure a hard-fought one-nil victory over Union Berlin in Round 28. Florian Wirtz's clinical finishing proved decisive, but it was Union's red card in the 47th minute that turned the game.
Gosens sent off in the 47th minute—Union Berlin reduced to ten men, in what turned out to be the match's pivotal turning point.
Wirtz strikes,  clinical from close range in the 52nd minute—one of his 11 for the campaign!
Tella's tight-angle effort tests the Union keeper
Adli has a golden opportunity to seal the result in the box at the death
Bayer Leverkusen edges past Hoffenheim two-one in a crucial Matchday 27 clash. Goals from Schick and Andrich keep their title ambitions firmly on track.
Beier strikes decisively in the thirty-second minute—Hoffenheim ahead one-nil, but Leverkusen's destiny remains unwritten!
Andrich produces a brilliant finish from that tight angle in the 87th minute—Leverkusen level it up, one-one!
Schick in the 90th minute—clinical finish in the box—Leverkusen goes two-one up and seal a dramatic win!
Bayer Leverkusen claimed a thrilling three-two victory over Freiburg in Round 26, extending their impressive campaign with another crucial three points.
Wirtz strikes in the opening minute with a difficult finish—what a statement! Leverkusen seize the lead instantly.
Doan strikes against the run of play in the ninth minute—Freiburg level at one all.
Hlozek scores on thirty-nine minutes—Leverkusen takes the lead they'll never surrender on this magical unbeaten journey!
Schick converts a difficult chance in the 52nd minute—clinical finishing puts Leverkusen in complete control at three-one!
Keitel pulls one back in the 78th minute with a tricky finish—two-three—but Leverkusen's invincibility remains intact!

Bayer Leverkusen put on a commanding display to defeat Wolfsburg two-nil in Round 25, a result that keeps them firmly in the title hunt. The visitors' hopes virtually evaporated early on when they were reduced to ten men in the 27th minute.
Wirtz twists from that tight angle on twenty-one minutes—a dangerous opportunity, but the Wolfsburg defense holds firm.
Jenz's 27th-minute red card dealt Wolfsburg a devastating blow, forcing them to battle with ten men from there on.
Tella´s close strike breaks the deadlock—Leverkusen lead at the midpoint!
Hincapie finds space from a tight angle, but his difficult chance doesn't trouble the keeper as Leverkusen press for a second.
Wirtz seals the deal in the 85th minute—clinical finishing seals it two-nil, another masterclass from Leverkusen's creative heartbeat!
